title: Data Engineer
description: Architect pipelines. Build large-scale data warehouses, ELT ingestion pipelines, data lakes, and stream processing pipelines.

nodes.title: SQL & Data Warehousing (Snowflake/BigQuery)
nodes.description: Master star schemas, index models, cluster distributions, query partitions, and analytical SQL querying.
projectIdeas: Design an analytical database schema on BigQuery staging tables using star schemas mapping dimensions.
interviewQuestions: What is the difference between transactional OLTP databases and warehouse OLAP databases?
Explain cluster keys in data warehouses.

nodes.title: ETL pipelines & Airflow Orchestration
nodes.description: Construct data extraction DAG structures, run schedule schedules, and trace task dependencies in pipelines.
projectIdeas: Write an Airflow DAG that pulls weather metrics daily from public APIs, cleans values, and appends records to Snowflake.
interviewQuestions: What is a DAG in pipeline orchestrations?
How do you handle pipeline task failures and retries in Airflow workflows?

nodes.title: Big Data Processing (Apache Spark)
nodes.description: Distribute computation across worker nodes. Master RDD frameworks, spark dataframes, and dynamic partitioning optimizations.
projectIdeas: Build a log analysis pipeline that parses 10GB of log records in a distributed manner using PySpark.
interviewQuestions: What is lazy evaluation in Spark and what is its benefit?
Explain the difference between actions and transformations in Spark.
